case_analysis.thread_summary: The thread discusses how to correctly explain Bluetooth SIG qualification obligations to a customer using a pre-qualified Bluetooth module in a branded end product. The internal review focuses on improving wording related to qualification requirements, Declaration ID obligations, and logo usage. The consultant corrects an oversimplified statement that implied registration was tied to logo usage. The final direction emphasizes that Bluetooth SIG qualification is required for Bluetooth products regardless of whether the Bluetooth logo is displayed.
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The exchange clarifies that using a pre-qualified Bluetooth module with an existing QDID does not eliminate the need for the final product company to complete a Bluetooth SIG declaration process. The thread distinguishes between module qualification reuse and final product Declaration ID registration under the seller's company name. The consultant references the Bluetooth SIG Help & Support guidance 'Do I Need to Qualify?' as the authoritative basis for the requirement. The discussion also separates qualification obligations from Bluetooth logo display decisions to avoid creating an incorrect compliance interpretation.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: Bluetooth SIG qualification obligations apply to products marketed and sold as Bluetooth products regardless of whether the Bluetooth logo is displayed on the product. A pre-qualified module QDID can support qualification reuse, but the final product seller must still complete the appropriate declaration and registration process under its own company identity.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrectly telling customers that qualification obligations depend on Bluetooth logo usage could lead companies to skip mandatory SIG declaration activities while still marketing Bluetooth-enabled products. This can create compliance exposure, delayed product launch readiness, or the need for corrective registration work after commercialization.
case_analysis.consulting_mistake: The initial draft response implied that qualification registration obligations were linked to Bluetooth logo usage. The consultant corrected this by reframing the explanation around Bluetooth SIG qualification requirements for Bluetooth products irrespective of logo display and by citing the official Bluetooth SIG Help & Support guidance as the authoritative source.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: When advising customers about Bluetooth SIG compliance, avoid framing qualification obligations around logo usage alone. Always explain that final product declaration requirements are tied to commercial distribution of Bluetooth products, even when pre-qualified modules are reused and even when the Bluetooth logo is not displayed.
